## New in this release

### New
- **Themed app icon on Android 13+:** with themed icons turned on (including Nothing OS's black-and-white look), the app icon now follows your theme instead of showing a generic substitute.
- **Dark and tinted app icon on iPhone and iPad (iOS 18+):** the icon matches the dark and tinted home screen styles.

### Known issues
- Parent accounts that log in through **ID Austria** don't work yet.
